symptomShortText: Fittings bottoming out in customer assembly

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-7201, Shift C - ran the released NC program without deviation
EQ-DRILL06-003 axis positioning verified 0.01mm, within the 0.03mm limit
DOC-9930 Rev D - drawing still carries the pre-revision 9.5mm thread depth after the M12 port was changed to a deeper fitting in 2026-05; the NC program was generated from this drawing
Aluminium billet lot AL-4420 cert PASS
Thread plug gauge GA-0511, last cal 2026-05-28, R&R 5.5%

fiveWhyChain.question: Why do the fittings bottom out?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Thread depth measured 9.2mm against a 14.0mm minimum, so the fitting reaches the bottom of the port before sealing

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the thread only 9.2mm deep?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The NC program drills to the 9.5mm depth carried on drawing DOC-9930 Rev D

fiveWhyChain.question: Why does the drawing still show 9.5mm after the port change?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The 2026-05 design change to a deeper fitting updated the fitting callout but not the port depth dimension

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the design change ship with an inconsistent drawing? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The change review checked the fitting selection but had no step requiring the mating feature dimensions to be re-verified against it

actions.actionText: Block all M12 stock and gauge thread depth on every unit at the customer and in transit
Correct DOC-9930 to Rev E with the 14.0mm port depth and regenerate the NC program
Re-drill 428 affected manifolds to the corrected depth where stock allows, scrap the remainder
Add a mandatory mating-feature dimension check to the engineering change review checklist

fmeaLink.description: Feature dimension not updated after design change

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Restricting the search to parts touched by the May design change narrowed 40 drawings down to one
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: The change review treated the fitting and the port it seats in as unrelated items

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: M12 manifolds drilled from DOC-9930 Rev D, produced after the 2026-05 design change
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: M10 and M16 manifolds - same line, same operators, drawings unaffected by the change
isIsNot.notes: Defect is confined to the part touched by the design change
